title: Law to expand crash reporting for e-bikes and scooters
summary: This bill would require the NYPD and the Department of Transportation to report crash data covering all micromobility devices, not just bicycles, including crashes between such devices and pedestrians or vehicles. The Department of Transportation would issue an annual report by June 1 each year, breaking down crashes by injuries, fatalities, location, time and device type, and would maintain a public interactive map updated at least monthly. It takes effect immediately upon passage.
